source.title: Call for Applicants - WCAT Leader (November 2023)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Competition Announcement Team Leader, as Wilson Alvis’s term is ending. We would like to thank Wilson for the work he has done leading the Team.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least minimum of 8 hours per week on average to work for the Team. 

**The qualities expected of candidates are:**

* Strong leadership skills to provide guidance, support, and direction to WCAT members
* High level of attention to detail to ensure accurate and compliant competition announcements.
* Strong decision making abilities
* Very good knowledge of the relevant policies, particularly the Competition Requirements Policy
* Excellent communication skills with an ability to convey information clearly and professionally

 <!-- break -->
The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until **27th November, 2023, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).
 
**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**

* Brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* Ambitions as the WCAT Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WCAT can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2021.2.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.2%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf)

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2022.0.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: 招募 WCA 比赛公示组负责人（2023 年 11 月）
translation.content:
Wilson Alvis 的任期即将结束，WCA 将任命新一届比赛公示组（WCAT）负责人。感谢 Wilson 在带领团队期间所做的工作。

候选人应完成整个任期（24 个月），平均每周至少投入 8 小时处理团队工作。

**我们希望候选人具备以下能力和素质：**

* 较强的领导能力，能够为 WCAT 成员提供指导、支持和方向。
* 十分注重细节，确保比赛公告准确、合规。
* 较强的决策能力。
* 非常熟悉相关政策，尤其是《比赛要求政策》。
* 出色的沟通能力，能够清晰、专业地传达信息。

申请期从即日起至 **2023 年 11 月 27 日 23:59 UTC**。有意申请者可将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：**

* 简短的个人介绍。
* 曾为 WCA 开展的工作概述。
* 担任 WCA 比赛公示组负责人后的工作设想。

此外，请提交一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料副本。

WCAT 的权利与职责见 [WCA 议案 10.2021.2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.2%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf)。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将投票选出人选，再由高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认，随后公布新负责人。流程详见 [WCA 议案 10.2022.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
